source: make a zombie apocalypse game where you have to survive waves where the zombies keep getting more and more. the setting is a ghost town and there is 3 zombie species, normal zombies (just fight) gold zombies (fight and cna levitate) and diamond zombies ( bigger and fights and fly) there is two circles on the right corner that say sprint and shoot. on the left corner there is gun, sword. and bat

image_prompt.text: Narrow points where the ghost town streets and alleys meet, concentrating the horde into ground the player can hold
Derelict ghost town buildings - storefronts and houses - that can be entered from the street
A deserted ghost town: empty main street, boarded storefronts, abandoned vehicles and debris

layout_placement.text: Zombie entry points around the edges of the town, sited so the player can read which direction a wave is coming from, with the count rising each wave
Three zombie species: normal ground fighters, gold zombies that levitate, and larger diamond zombies that fly
Waves that keep growing in number

notes: Two of the three enemy types leave the ground, so spawner-npc - written as an entry point plus the ground it patrols - only covers one third of the threat.
All five control buttons the prompt describes are screen-space and have no layout footprint.

open_questions.ask: Is this one main street to hold, or a whole town to move through between waves?
Is there a wave you can win at, or does it run until you die?

theme: Post-Apocalyptic - abandoned ghost town, weathered timber, dust and debris

coverage_missing.ask: One street or a whole town?
Does the game end at a final wave?
Do the flying zombies need rooftops and high ground to be a threat, or do they just hover over the street?

answers.ask: Is this one main street to hold, or a whole town to move through between waves?
answers.answer: Use one main street in the ghost town as the small survival arena to hold.

answers.ask: Is there a wave you can win at, or does it run until you die?
answers.answer: It runs until you die, with each wave increasing the number of zombies.
